rows.label: tlk70000048_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I was worried about how my kids would
adjust to being brought here...

rows.label: tlk70000048_03_msg0002
rows.name:
The younger people here often look out
for them, and it's a great help.

rows.label: tlk70000048_03_msg0003
rows.name:
My kids have been getting along
famously with Noel and Ivan. They
eat together and everything.

rows.label: tlk70000048_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Those two lost their families,
too, so it was easy for my
kids to relate to them.

rows.label: tlk70000048_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I really should be by their side, but
I can't always manage that...

rows.label: tlk70000048_03_msg0006
rows.name: Ahh, if only Nei were here...
